description: Slack Web API, Events API and related APIs for building apps in Slack workspaces.
auth_notes: Apps authenticate via OAuth 2.0 and obtain user, bot or app tokens governed by scopes; token rotation is supported.
gate_detail: Tokens come from OAuth with scopes set in app settings. Commercial distribution requires a separate agreement, typically Marketplace submission or a partner agreement; internal-only apps are not stated to need review. Free signup details not stated.
api_scope: Web API HTTP methods, Events API (HTTP or Socket Mode), plus Admin, SCIM and Audit Logs APIs for specific use cases.
mcp_notes: Sources show no Slack-published MCP server; the apis.io MCP listed is a third-party catalog.
blocker_detail: Commercially distributed apps need Marketplace agreement or partner agreement; workspace admin approval to install is not stated.

evidence.quote: Before your app can access Slack data or interact with Slack workspaces, it must go through an authentication process.
OAuth 2.0 : Learn how to use OAuth 2.0 to securely authenticate users and request access tokens.
For most Applications, obtaining a separate agreement that authorises Commercial Distribution simply means submitting to our Marketplace and agreeing to the Marketplace Agreement
The Web API supplies a collection of HTTP methods that underpin the majority of Slack app functionality.
Subscribe to the events you want from a range of possibilities.

uncertainties: Sources do not state how a developer first obtains credentials or whether a free workspace suffices.
SDK and CLI styles are only hinted at in the API terms.
